_readme: legacy: the old single hand total. Used only as a placeholder for axes that have neither data nor a hand value.

hand: hand sub-scores on the ORIGINAL rubric scale (moat /30, quality /25, growth /20, valuation /20). The scorer converts them pro rata to the live weights (moat /40, quality /30, growth /20, valuation /10). quality, growth and valuation are overridden by fundamentals when available.
moat_answers: five true/false answers to the moat questions in FRAMEWORK.md, 8 points each (switching costs, network effects, intangibles, cost advantage, durability). When set, replaces hand.moat.
moat_date: YYYY-MM-DD the moat was last judged. null or older than 120 days is flagged on the dashboard.
kind "fund": ETFs and funds keep their legacy score; no fundamentals are applied.

industry: optional override of Finnhub's industry label, used to compare gross and free-cash-flow margins with true peers (Finnhub puts hardware makers in "Technology" with software). Needs 5+ peers with data.
moat_by: who set the moat answers. "claude-draft" = awaiting review; "claude, accepted by Dharam <date>" = drafted by Claude and accepted; your own name once you override.
